title: Typography by @rajputrajesh448: New Release — Blubird is a contemporary sans serif typeface with disti
notes:
New Release — Blubird is a contemporary sans serif typeface with distinctive narrow proportions and a confident, expressive character. It features 9 weights, 36 styles, and two optical sizes—Display and Text.

Designer: @rajputrajesh448. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
